messages:
Iris: quick note — a customer reported a broken inline reference from the "Getting Started" quickstart to the runtime config example. 404 when they click the snippet link. Anyone near this doc? :thinking: Ben: which snippet link? the env var example or the runtime flags? Iris: the env var block that points to `/kb/runtime/config#env-vars`. It jumps to top of page instead of fragment in prod. Leah (Docs): that usually means the heading slug changed. I can grep for the heading. Ben: running: `rg "env-vars" content/ -n || true` shows heading renamed to "Environment variables" -> slug `environment-variables`. Old anchor was `env-vars`. Leah (Docs): plan: add a compat id on the heading and update the quickstart to use the canonical slug. I'll open a two-part PR: 1) add `

Environment variables

` compatibility line, 2) sweep high-traffic callers to update links. Aaron: tiny ask: can we canary the compat-only change first (no caller updates) so links resolve while we prepare the sweep? avoids breaking cached templates. link-monitor-bot: nightly fragment-scan flagged 5 broken fragment links to `#env-vars` across docs. Ticket KB-7744 created. Iris: canary sounds good. Leah, if you post the PR link here I'll QA staging against the onboarding email and onboarding site. Leah (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9001 - branch fix/env-compat. Includes staging-only label for canary. CI green. Ben: quick check on staging looks good. Fragment resolves to the heading and deep link works. I'll follow up with a sweep PR to update the callers to `#environment-variables` after this merges. Aaron: thanks team. tagging @support to close the customer ticket. Small fixes like this reduce churn. :sparkles:
